configuration.label_relation: exact existing target equality/inequality or unavailable; no imputation
configuration.control_population: initially excluded, retained and excluded at least once, never admitted within declared core checkpoint union
configuration.stratum_quotas: equal quotient with fixed-order remainder across four bands times label-relation cells
configuration.missing_or_scarce_strata: census available units; no favorable refill and no cross-stratum transfer
configuration.pair_rule: one seeded uniform former blocker per record; fixed across all request occurrences
configuration.repeated_pairs: sample role strata independently; deduplicate human assignments; union probability one minus product nonselection
configuration.inclusion_scope: conditional on complete frozen core checkpoint union and realized fixed former-blocker choices
configuration.target_scope: unique pairs in declared frame; not all possible deletions, not all blocker pairs, not a causal control

requires: predeclared uniform subset of admission records
exact nearest similarity with stable-ID ties
surviving_selected_audit.scope: exploratory interpretation; not corpus recovery or global novelty guarantee
